--- a/solution.py
+++ b/solution.py
@@ -1,2 +1,29 @@
 def merge_intervals(intervals):
-    return list(intervals)
+    """Merge overlapping or touching closed intervals.
+
+    Accepts any iterable of (start, end) pairs, leaves the caller's data
+    untouched, and returns a new sorted list of tuples. Raises ValueError
+    if any interval has start > end.
+    """
+    pairs = []
+    for item in intervals:
+        start, end = item
+        if start > end:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "invalid interval: start %r exceeds end %r" % (start, end)
+            )
+        pairs.append((start, end))
+    if not pairs:
+        return []
+    pairs.sort(key=lambda p: (p[0], p[1]))
+    merged = []
+    cur_start, cur_end = pairs[0]
+    for start, end in pairs[1:]:
+        if start <= cur_end:
+            if end > cur_end:
+                cur_end = end
+        else:
+            merged.append((cur_start, cur_end))
+            cur_start, cur_end = start, end
+    merged.append((cur_start, cur_end))
+    return merged
